set.summary: With the gauntlet formed, Carl has 16 Strength. Its three points are conditional.
Katia wears a ring from an early loot box that grants 15 Constitution. Other buffs also contribute to her displayed total.
Katia drinks the potion in her Gold Savage Box and learns Find Crawler 3. It locates nearby crawlers on her map.
